stage1.impression: A competent, well-composed CG interior with good depth, a warm timber ceiling and believable haze in the pendant cones, but it does not read as a photograph: the multicoloured ring globe reads as an LED art installation or club signage rather than thick polished acrylic, the floor's blotchy mottle and the pale, flat-lit zinc counter read as CG surfaces, and the back speakers glare grey-white instead of glowing smoked acrylic. As a specific place it is halfway there: the globe and the altar give it an identity, but the repeated identical stools, orbs and tables make the rest read as a generic catalogue bar.

blocking_9: Mother EARF must read as six thick, polished cast-acrylic discs with glowing edges and visible faces catching reflections, not as thin neon hoops (rims at most about 1.5 stops above the room's lit surfaces; disc faces visibly lighter than the ceiling behind them)
The floor must read as honed concrete at real scale: warm under 2700 K, without large blotchy dapples (r_median above g_median by 6 or more; no mottle patches larger than a stool seat)
The zinc counter must be a dark, patinated metal with pools of light under each Dome, not an evenly pale strip (lum_median of the counter top 70 to 110)
The altar and back-bar speakers must show their smoked tint and the light through their acrylic, with no glare-white faces (p95 below 210, visibly warm-grey and not neutral-white)
The right-hand screens must not read as flat grey voids; the large one at the right edge should be dimmer or show its image with some depth
Some sign of life must be legible from the camera (the coat, a glass with liquid in it, the record out of its sleeve) in the foreground third

defects.what: Mother EARF reads as thin saturated neon hoops; the 25 mm disc faces are nearly invisible, so it looks like an LED wireframe sphere or club signage; the top of the globe nearly touches the frame edge
Floor mottle reads as large cloud-like dapples or water stains, cold neutral grey (r68 g62 b60) against a warm room; reads as a CG texture, not honed concrete
Zinc counter top is pale and evenly lit (median 143, p95 232), reading as a lit white worktop rather than dark zinc
Left altar speaker face glares grey-white (p95 224) with no smoked tint; reads as a flat cut-out under its spot
Right altar speaker, same glare and loss of tint (p95 197)
Back-bar speaker in its niche is a low-contrast neutral grey (r125 g123 b122) and looks hazed over, like a photo pasted into the niche
Large screen at the right edge is a flat grey-violet void, cropped by the frame edge, with no image legible
Smaller screen also reads as a dark empty panel
Bar stools are identical copies in a perfect row, so they read as a catalogue array; the flat board backrests read as plywood placeholders
Orb table lamps are identical bright white balls in a repeated line; they read as white plastic globes rather than smoked acrylic over a frosted liner
Banquette foreground is murky (median 17, crush 8 %), its leather has no sheen and no props or life
Coloured shadow on the wall has a near-white core band (median 105) that reads like a projector stripe; acceptable as intended, but hot

changes.problem: The globe's rims glow like neon tube while its disc faces stay dark, so the centrepiece reads as LED signage, not thick cast acrylic.

evidence.measured: rim p95 142 with 1.07 % clipped against a body median of 22 across the globe box [610,0,880,290]; at 2x crop the disc faces are only faintly visible and the rims are uniform saturated bands

change.setting: Mother EARF rim glow, and its hard spot
change.from: rim glow 0.03; hard spot 145 W, cone 24 deg
change.to: rim glow 0.015; hard spot 145 W, cone widened to 32 deg so it washes across the disc faces, plus a weak warm 2700 K soft fill (about 10 W area lamp) from camera side, aimed to put a clean reflection streak on each disc face

changes.expected: The rims glow but read as polished edges; the faces show broad reflections and some tint, so the discs read as 25 mm slabs of acrylic; globe body median rises to about 32 to 40 and rim clipping falls to zero

changes.problem: The floor's mottle reads as large blotchy dapples in cold grey, the strongest 'render' signal in the frame.

evidence.measured: median 63.5, r68 g62 b60 (neutral-cold), range 127; large dark cloud patches at 1:1

change.from: tone mottle +/-7 % at large scale, honed sealer
change.to: tone mottle +/-3 % at a finer scale (patches under 30 cm), roughness mottle +/-10 %, a warmer, darker base (about 15 % darker), and a few aggregate flecks and saw-cut joints at 1.2 m

changes.expected: The floor reads as honed concrete at real scale, warm under the room's light, darker so the stools' shadows carry it

changes.problem: The altar pair glares grey-white and loses its smoked tint, so EARF's own speakers read as cut-outs.

evidence.measured: p95 224, r33 g30 b30 median, neutral; right speaker [655,355,705,435] p95 197

change.to: 55 W, cone 22 deg, aimed to graze the cabinets from above so light passes through the acrylic

changes.expected: Speaker faces sit in a pool rather than a flood, the smoked tint and white batts behind it read, no glare

changes.problem: The zinc counter is evenly pale, reading as a white lit worktop with no pools under the Domes.

change.setting: lamps: the Domes' downlights, and the zinc
change.from: 4 x spot 26.0 W, cone 16 deg; zinc as now
change.to: 4 x spot 16 W, cone 14 deg; zinc base about 20 % darker with a slightly higher sheen so each pool reads as a reflection

changes.expected: Distinct pools of light under each Dome with dark zinc between, glasses catching small highlights

changes.problem: No sign of life reads in the foreground; the banquette is murky and empty and the props named on the card are not legible from this camera.

evidence.measured: median 17, crush 8.2 %; no glass, coat or record visible in the foreground

change.from: props at the counter and zone, out of the foreground; Orb 0.1 W, glow 0.003
change.to: a rocks glass with ice and a half-drunk coupe on the nearest banquette table [~790,640], a record and sleeve on the banquette seat, a coat thrown over the nearest tub chair; Orb 0.2 W so the nearest table and seat leather catch a soft pool

changes.expected: The foreground has life and the banquette leather shows a sheen; region median rises to 22 to 30

changes.problem: Repeated identical stools in a perfect row and identical orbs read as catalogue copies.

evidence.measured: visually identical rotation and spacing on six counter stools; four orbs in a straight line

change.setting: the seats and the banquette tables: small turns and offsets
change.to: counter stools up to 20 deg turn, 6 cm offset; one stool pushed back 25 cm, one turned towards the room; vary each Orb's glow +/-25 %

changes.expected: The row reads as used, not set out for a catalogue

changes.problem: The right-hand screens are flat grey voids, and the large one is cut by the frame edge.

evidence.measured: median 67, range 76, flat grey-violet (r75 g64 b72) with no image legible

change.to: 0.015, so they sit back as dark images with a hint of content rather than lit grey panels

changes.expected: Screens recede to deep, quiet images; the right edge stops pulling the eye

changes.problem: The globe's top nearly touches the frame edge, and the eye-height camera makes the room read as a wide architectural render rather than a guest's view.

evidence.measured: globe rim reaches y of about 5 px

changes.expected: The globe sits fully inside the frame with headroom; slightly more of the room and floor in view

out_of_scope.request: Make Mother EARF's discs read as solid slotted discs rather than open rings (if the model's discs are hollow rings)
out_of_scope.why: It is the product's shape, fixed by the card; only light and finish around it may change

out_of_scope.request: Tone down the six saturated rim colours
out_of_scope.why: The owner chose these colours; the card fixes them

out_of_scope.request: Replace the flat board backrests on the counter stools
out_of_scope.why: The seats are part of the room's design as proposed, fixed by the card

out_of_scope.request: Show the smoked tint on the Dome pendants, which read as milky white
out_of_scope.why: The lamps' parts and tint are EARF's products, fixed; only their glow level may change
